title: Setup → Positions editor: no Permission Sets field until the first save, an icon-only Save, Remove holder with no confirm, and a holder picker that offers a user removed from the organization (hotcrm#2194 R2-T2-U02)
body:
## 维护者速读

- **事由：** 新建岗位时看不到权限集字段，要先保存草稿；保存按钮只有图标；移除持有人不确认；持有人选择器还列出已被移出组织的用户。
- **要做：** 创建时就显示权限集；保存按钮带文字；移除持有人前确认；选择器只列组织成员。
- **完成标准：** 一次就能建好并绑定权限集的岗位，且不会误删持有人。

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194, recorded there at `6354968262` (the director seat, posting from the maintainer's account): 「25251 B hotcrm B」, 2026-10-23T01:05:47Z. That is letter B for all three rounds, exactly as the seat recommended, and it adopts **R2-T2-U02**. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 1 (`os-elon-musk`, session `session_014xanhPEmGTMTfVH4UokwJT`) under objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's *After the ruling*. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Grade:** triage's. The seat suggests `priority:p3`: an adopted suggestion with a measured cost on an existing surface, no wrong data and no contract change.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes and grades it. The landing below is the seat's reading of `origin/main`; paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## Governing text

- The ruling above. Per objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2194's own governing text, this item is an adopted suggestion through filing gate ②, not a defect card, and a platform or console landing is changed there, never re-implemented in HotCRM: 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台。」 (maintainer, 2026-10-18, ledger `6245607810`).

## Why (measured)

- **Page / persona:** Setup → Positions (create and edit), the system administrator.
- **Now (18.0.0):** the create form has no Permission Sets field; it appears only after the first save. Save is an icon-only "Save (⌘S)". Remove holder acts with no confirm. The holder picker lists a user removed from the organization (QA Csv).
- **Cost:** binding a set took 3 steps (save draft, add set, save, publish).
- **Evidence:** objectstack-ai/hotcrm [round 2 track 2 report, *UI and UX suggestions*](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/REPORT.md), U-02; [`12-access-positions-new-filled.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/12-access-positions-new-filled.png), [`12-access-positions-add-holder.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/4d7cc467dcb08226fea5b8a1b2ea89ee05d6353b/qa/2026-10-20-v18-setup/shots/12-access-positions-add-holder.png).

## Landing

- The console's metadata editor for the `position` type and its holder section (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`). #13304 (closed) already fixed the preview's reading of `permissionSets`.
- The holder picker's candidate list must be the organization's members, by the server's membership, not a client filter.

## Done when

- New Position shows Permission Sets at once; Save is labelled; Remove holder confirms and names the user; the holder picker offers organization members only.
- Tests on each of the four.

**Size:** S.

## Dedupe

Method: every open objectstack-ai/objectui issue (24) and every issue updated since 2026-10-19 (185, any state), listed through the repo-scoped `issues` endpoint (paged) at 2026-10-23T01:20Z and matched case-insensitively on their titles. Words: `position`, `holder`. 1 open hit: #12724 (AI build chat), not on point; #13304 (closed, the preview) is a different defect. **New.**
